budget_items.topic: Minimum wage and the salary grid
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The state minimum wage is currently $14.25 per hour and rises to $15.00 next year; the change would be quite dramatic to Grades 1 through 3, and the cost of any change was to be reviewed.
budget_items.quote: that rate is currently $14.25ph and will go up again next year to $15.00.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Several options were discussed and the cost of each reviewed; the group said the town's budget implications had to be considered.
budget_items.quote: several options were discussed and the impact the cost of any change reviewed.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A Board Clerk/Secretary hire was placed at Grade 6 Step 2 because candidates with experience need to be placed at a higher step.
budget_items.quote: candidates with experience need to be brought in at a step higher in the salary grade

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The warrant language covered approval of a replacement Salary Schedule for FY23, FY24 and FY25.
budget_items.quote: the approval of the replacement salary schedule for fy23, fy24 and fy25.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Staff agreed to provide financial information needed for a full budget assessment of salary options; no dollar figure was printed.
budget_items.quote: j. belliveau and n. forest agreed to assist him with additional financial information that would allow of full budget assessment.
